game.css: .game-hud{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin:0 0 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}.hud-cell{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);padding:8px 16px;text-align:center;min-width:74px}.hud-lab{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--dim);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.hud-cell b{font-size:22px;color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--mono)}.game-hud.shake{animation:hshake .3s}@keyframes hshake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}25%{transform:translateX(-6px)}75%{transform:translateX(6px)}}.lvl-fx{position:absolute;left:50%;top:40%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-size:34px;font-weight:800;color:var(--accent);text-shadow:0 0 20px var(--accent);pointer-events:none;animation:lvlup 1.2s ease-out forwards;z-index:5}@keyframes lvlup{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.5)}20%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.15)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-90%) scale(1)}}.variant-res{margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.vr-title{font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--dim);margin-bottom:10px}.vr-grid{display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}.vr-grid>div{text-align:center}.vr-grid b{display:block;font-size:26px;color:var(--accent);font-family:var(--mono)}.vr-grid span{font-size:11px;color:var(--dim)}.spark{position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);pointer-events:none;z-index:4;animation:spark .5s ease-out forwards}@keyframes spark{0%{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--dx),var(--dy)) scale(.3)}}.vr-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--soft);text-align:center}
